studies.zone: Old Orchard Cellars — displaced Goblin worker families and purchased preserves
studies.room: earth-insulated occupied fruit cellar with root table and warm brazier; small wood and masonry cavity
studies.description: Former fruit cellar now sleeping, gathering, storing purchased preserves and playing games; quiet, slightly warm enclosed air and one restrained real domestic object gesture. Do not fabricate Goblin voices, panicked children, cooking loop or theft.
studies.negative: no abandoned horror crypt, monster growl, breakage, uncanny roof moan, constant cutlery, forced labor sounds

studies.zone: Drowned Watchhouse — Reed Beast shelter above partial floodwater
studies.room: flood-damp abandoned military shell now inhabited, with reed nests, fishing nets and fish racks
studies.description: Quiet occupied shallow-water shelter with restrained recorded wet air; one attenuated swale texture as optional comparison, not a constant outdoor river. No claim about Archive's flood origin or new Reed Beast calls.
studies.negative: no generic haunted watchtower, permanent torrent, dripping metronome, frog chorus, invented clue, Reed Beast vocal sample

studies.zone: Ruined Foundry — active Crown repair forge, repair benches, kitchen and bunks

studies.description: Functioning damaged Crown forge: dry warm mineral/air presence and two isolated believable workshop gestures. Men stationed here have bunks, racks, field kitchen; do not imply modern factory, perpetual rhythmic forge hammer or deployed machinery.
